note: Set B is better because it correctly binds the 15 m diameter to LUVOIR-A and the 4 science instruments to HabEx, whereas Set A uses vague entities like 'on-axis telescope' and 'spacecraft' for these facts. Set A also contains a factually incorrect claim stating the grazing incidence mirror assembly diameter is 10 m (text says 3 m diameter, 10 m focal length), while Set B uses vague terms like 'size' or 'dimension' for the 10 m value which are less contradictory. Both sets suffer from OCR errors ('n-axis' in B, 'axis' in A) and duplicates, but B's specific entity bindings are more accurate.
